newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia higher on active overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Nokia higher on active overseas demand.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy rose further on active overseas demand following the release of its in-line January-September report, brokers said.
At 1410/1210 GMT, Nokia's A series share traded 6.6 percent or 15.00 markka higher at 242.00 markka -- its highest since November 29 last year.
Volume was heavy at around 310 million markka, accounting for some 83 percent of total Helsinki bourse turnover.
Brokers said particularly foreign investors were actively buying the share.
"Domestic players have been more or less confused by the surge in the share price," one said.
Nokia's January-September pre-tax profit fell to 2,228 million markka from 3,984 million in the same period in 1995. The profit was in line with analysts' forecasts.
Operators said sales growth in the mobile phones sector had been particularly impressive.
